# Dark Reader API

Loaded from the APK only when a light page needs night mode. No CDN or remote code.
The wrapper disables image analysis, restricts extra stylesheet fetches to HTTPS
on the document origin without cookies or redirects, and removes observers when
hidden or disabled. See DARKREADER-LICENSE.
